C-R8-PROTOCOL-PROFILE-326.Summary: Extend the existing deterministic department-protocol parser with optional reusable profile fields while preserving immutable source, machine evidence and manual working corrections.
C-R8-PROTOCOL-PROFILE-326.Problem: Recognized protocols currently bypass generic document templates, so a stable local protocol format cannot add narrowly defined fields without changing the base parser. A profile must add evidence-backed facts without becoming a second parser, overwriting manual corrections or making optional adapter errors fatal.

Goals.Goal: Reuse active document templates with document_type department_protocol as an optional deterministic profile layer after the base parser.
Persist each profile field in the current extraction run with its exact document-version locator and materialize only safe canonical fields that the base parser left empty.
Keep manual working values authoritative on reprocess; conflicting machine values remain queryable and create review-by-exception instead of overwrite.
Keep one broken profile local so the saved source and successful base protocol remain usable.
Prove the mechanism on two explicitly synthetic same-format fixtures while leaving real two-document acceptance open in Issue 326.

Constraints.Constraint: No SQLite schema or migration change, no VERSION change and no new form-builder.
Base department_protocol extraction remains the primary deterministic parser and works without any profile or LLM.
Profile materialization never changes blob SHA-256 or document_version and never rewrites an older extraction run.
Profile aliases are explicit and narrow; generic date/number guesses are forbidden.
Synthetic fixtures are regression evidence only and cannot satisfy the real-sample acceptance criterion of Issue 326.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Build a universal no-code parser, ML classifier or mandatory LLM workflow.
Add new storage tables for profile definitions or profile runs.
Close Issue 326 without two anonymized real recurring protocol documents.
Replace the existing protocol correction, review or reprocess UI.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: One department_protocol template extracts the synthetic recurring field from both regression documents and each machine field carries a source locator.
A profile-filled canonical protocol number is materialized only when the base parser and working meeting field are empty, and meeting evidence records its document version and locator.

After an operator changes the working protocol number, reprocess creates a new extraction run on the same immutable document version, preserves the operator value, retains the new machine value and opens a conflict review.
A malformed second profile produces a local review while the good profile and base meeting remain available and the document is not marked failed solely for that adapter error.
Without a matching profile, the existing department_protocol flow is unchanged and requires no LLM.
Documentation explicitly states that real two-document acceptance is pending and Issue 326 remains open after this mechanism PR.
Targeted protocol-profile tests, ordinary project CI and GRACE final scope/lint pass on one exact PR head.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Exact-head tests prove same-format reuse, field locator provenance, same-version reprocess history, manual-value precedence and profile partial failure without schema changes; real-world format quality remains explicitly unproven.
